numerical_failure.observed_behavior: rv_discrete.ppf (default implementation via _drv2_ppfsingle) enters an infinite loop for logser(0.25739239425774363).ppf(0.9999999999999999) and never returns; the loop is in the bracketing/bisection search in _drv2_ppfsingle (the reporter interrupted it with KeyboardInterrupt, traceback through _cdf_single and _pmf).
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: The call should return a finite quantile or raise an error rather than looping forever; the reference run on another setup returns inf for st.logser(0.25739239425774363).ppf(0.99999999999999999).
trigger_conditions: distribution is an rv_discrete using the default _drv2_ppfsingle implementation (e.g. scipy.stats.logser)
q=0.9999999999999999 (ppf called with a quantile extremely close to 1)
reported only in a Conda installation; other setups reportedly work
original code stepped integer bounds by 10 each iteration, so bracketing could not overflow in practice

input_output_examples.expected_output: finite value or an error; the reference run returns inf for ppf(0.99999999999999999)

oracle_clues: PR discussion says overflow should raise RuntimeError with message 'Arguments that bracket the requested quantile could not be found.' when a or b is infinite
fix uses float arguments to _cdf and doubles the step each iteration so overflow happens within a few hundred iterations
PR discussion mentions maximum bisection count within normal float64s, and bisection bound of 9e307 vs np.finfo(float).max 1.8e308

numerical_characteristics.magnitude: values approaching the largest finite float64 (e.g. around 9e307 to 1.8e308, np.finfo(float).max); overflow to inf is the failure mode
category_specific_evidence: Infinite loop in rv_discrete._drv2_ppfsingle bisection bracketing (gh-20048), reported for logser.ppf
Original code stepped by fixed increments of 10 and converted bracket starts with int(), passing Python ints to _cdf rather than floats
Fix uses float starting points and doubles the step each iteration so overflow occurs within a few hundred iterations
Overflow now raises RuntimeError with message 'Arguments that bracket...' instead of looping forever
Issue reproduces via logser(0.25739239425774363).ppf(0.99999999999999999) hanging, with the cdf not strictly increasing on some platforms due to floating point arithmetic
Test test_gh20048 uses a custom rv_discrete with _cdf returning min(k/100, 0.99) and b=np.inf, and expects RuntimeError from ppf(0.999)
reproduction_risks: The CI platform could not reproduce the issue; a synthetic distribution was needed
On some platforms the cdf is not strictly increasing due to floating point rounding, so the failure depends on platform arithmetic
The expected error is only the one raised after overflow; the root could lie in the last representable magnitude and be missed
